ca395d166036.curator_note: Friday's edition of the rooftop series you keep coming back to — eight floors over DTLA, sun going down, rotating local house DJs keeping it smooth and skip-free. Free with RSVP, so just walk in early before it caps.
ca395d166036.description: Weekly Friday rooftop house party (5-10pm) at Golden Hour on Level 8 in downtown LA, with rotating local DJs.

a1aee8bcdfae.curator_note: A long-running soulful-electronic night at El Cid for $7 — the kind of low-key, groove-forward room where the selection does the work and nobody's filming. Easy eastside add to a Friday.
a1aee8bcdfae.description: Soulful electronic dance night at El Cid in Silver Lake, doors 10pm, $7.

artist_notes.name: DJ Nuts
artist_notes.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

artist_notes.name: Cut Chemist
artist_notes.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

918a63422186.curator_note: A Mochilla-style 'Like No One Is Watching' digger summit — DJ Nuts and Cut Chemist trading rare grooves with Detroit's Waajeed in the mix. Less peak-time, more for people who care about where the records come from; the Friday move if you'd rather nerd out than rage.
918a63422186.description: Mochilla's 'Like No One Is Watching' all-vinyl global-beats party at 2220 Arts + Archives with DJ Nuts, Waajeed, Cut Chemist and guests; $20.

8d2a98275ab5.curator_note: Vidiots kicks off a Bill Duke weekend with his 1992 LA narco-noir — Laurence Fishburne undercover, Jeff Goldblum sleazy, and an underrated entry in early-'90s Black cinema. Good excuse to finally try the Eagle Rock theater you've been meaning to hit.
8d2a98275ab5.description: Bill Duke's 1992 neo-noir 'Deep Cover' (108 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 7pm, opening a weekend tribute to the director.

artist_notes.name: SHDW
artist_notes.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

2d20ff8e0c2b.curator_note: An all-night-long set from one of modern techno's rhythm specialists, location-TBA-until-two-hours-before like WORK always does it. This is the proper hypnotic-techno end of the weekend — go if you want one DJ taking you the whole way, not the rooftop-groove night.
2d20ff8e0c2b.description: WORK presents German techno DJ SHDW (Mutual Rytm) for an all-night-long set at a location-TBA warehouse in LA, 11pm, tickets from $30.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

0f24a39aa490.curator_note: Bradley Zero headlining a Midnight Lovers open-air day party is about as close to that Sunset Sessions feeling as the weekend gets — sun, disco-leaning house, real selection, no requests. Build Saturday around the 5pm start.
0f24a39aa490.description: Midnight Lovers summer open-air day party at The Bridge with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero plus Masha Mar and LA selectors, from 5pm.

7d0bd069c0e5.curator_note: A sapphic Pride-weekend day party — more community-and-vibes than a billed-DJ night, so it's about the room, not the selection. On the radar if Pride is the priority over the music.
7d0bd069c0e5.description: Sapphic Pride day party 'Hot Girl Summer' at Untamed Spirits, from 3pm, $10.

f44b5d9fe86c.curator_note: Gold Diggers' twice-monthly disco party in East Hollywood — a reliably fun late Saturday for boogie and classic house in an intimate room a short hop from Silver Lake. No headliner billed, but the residents know the format.
f44b5d9fe86c.description: 'The Hustle' first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

96c73b45a50b.curator_note: A Juneteenth-weekend morning run/wellness gathering at CAAM in Exposition Park — a culture-and-community event, not a music one. Mentioning it for the weekend context, not the lane.
96c73b45a50b.description: Free 'Run The Culture' morning run and community event at the California African American Museum, 9am.

artist_notes.name: Neeko
artist_notes.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

artist_notes.name: Krane
artist_notes.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

cc5a11b4ddb8.curator_note: Sunday Sessions is one of the bigger vinyl-only crews in the country, and this is their open-air Apotheke session — exactly the all-wax, no-laptop house you want closing out a solstice Sunday. Low-key but the real deal.
cc5a11b4ddb8.description: Sunday Sessions LA vinyl-only open-air house session at Apotheke with residents Neeko and Krane, from 6pm.

5dcdfc5a574d.curator_note: Bill Duke was in the cast, which is why Vidiots slots 'Predator' into his weekend — and a 35mm print of the 1987 jungle classic is the right way to see it. Already sold out, so it's a 'if you have a ticket' note.
5dcdfc5a574d.description: John McTiernan's 'Predator' (1987, 107 min) on 35mm at Vidiots in Eagle Rock, 3:30pm, as part of the Bill Duke weekend — SOLD OUT.

artist_notes.name: AYYBO
artist_notes.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

artist_notes.name: Ragie Ban
artist_notes.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

6af20e062172.curator_note: The first of a three-night Lake takeover of the park, and the 18+ Friday is the loosest of them — go for the wide-open-field, hands-up version of his sound rather than a tasteful one.
6af20e062172.description: Goldenvoice/Framework present Chris Lake headlining an open-air tech-house party at LA State Historic Park, with AYYBO and Ragie Ban (18+).

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Josh Caffé
artist_notes.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

750cc2565824.curator_note: A location-TBA late one pairing a Detroit lifer with one of the few real vocalists in house — the kind of small, queer-leaning warehouse night that tends to outshine the big rooms this weekend.
750cc2565824.description: Late-night TBA-location house party with Detroit's DJ Minx and London vocalist-DJ Josh Caffé.

artist_notes.name: FARRALONE
artist_notes.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

35bde3a221a0.curator_note: Free-with-RSVP weekly leaning disco and nu-disco — low-stakes and unpretentious, the kind of spot to start a Friday before something bigger rather than make the whole night.
35bde3a221a0.description: Free weekly disco/nu-disco/house party at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang with residents FARRALONE and Alex D.

artist_notes.name: Waajeed
artist_notes.note: Detroit producer (Dirt Tech Reck, ex-Slum Village camp) — tracked artist; soulful, politically-charged techno and house from the source.

artist_notes.name: Trovarsi
artist_notes.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

artist_notes.name: E.M. Bae
artist_notes.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

artist_notes.name: 92Jelani
artist_notes.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

60356bc699f9.curator_note: A Juneteenth warehouse rave from Black Techno Matters with Waajeed anchoring it — techno reconnected to its Black Detroit roots, which is about the most meaningful way to spend the holiday on a dancefloor.
60356bc699f9.description: Juneteenth warehouse techno party (location TBA) presented by the Black Techno Matters collective, headlined by Detroit's Waajeed.

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

7d3eee612155.curator_note: The strongest night of the Lake run — adding Hot Since 82 gives the open-air a deeper, more European backbone than the Friday, so this is the one to prioritize if you only do one.
7d3eee612155.description: Chris Lake headlines LA State Historic Park with UK house don Hot Since 82 and Club de Combat (Goldenvoice/Framework).

artist_notes.name: Claude VonStroke
artist_notes.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

artist_notes.name: Ardalan
artist_notes.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch and Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: Todd Edwards
artist_notes.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

artist_notes.name: Cut Snake
artist_notes.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

artist_notes.name: Falcons
artist_notes.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

367d5cd8ea2a.curator_note: World Cup watch party crossed with a Dirtybird-deep DJ marathon on giant LED screens — a goofy premise on paper, but a genuinely stacked all-day bill that justifies showing up even if you don't care about the football.
367d5cd8ea2a.description: KCRW x Copa Del Rave: an all-day World Cup watch-party-meets-rave at Academy LA with LED match screens and DJs including Claude VonStroke, Todd Edwards, DJ Minx and Ardalan.

artist_notes.name: Ak'chamel, The Giver of Illness
artist_notes.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

artist_notes.name: Derek Monypeny
artist_notes.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

d0dd0d0bf550.curator_note: Not an electronic night at all — this is the heady, masked-ritual psych-folk corner of Zebulon, worth it if you want a left-field listening experience instead of a dancefloor this weekend.
d0dd0d0bf550.description: Experimental psych-folk/drone bill at Zebulon: anonymous Texas duo Ak'chamel, plus Joshua Tree guitarist Derek Monypeny and Kelby Clark.

artist_notes.name: Bradley Zero
artist_notes.note: Rhythm Section International boss out of Peckham — tracked artist; genre-fluid digger (disco, broken beat, deep house) and a touchstone for exactly this rooftop/warehouse-groove taste.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector (NTS, dublab; co-founder of Dig Deeper LA) — cosmic disco, tribal and left-field deep house.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

82f9690b2933.curator_note: A 10-hour Bradley Zero session with two of LA's sharpest diggers warming up is the headphones-and-dancing pick of the weekend — build the night around this rather than treating it as a backup.
82f9690b2933.description: Midnight Lovers presents a long-form warehouse party with Rhythm Section's Bradley Zero alongside Masha Mar, Xica Soul and Maddy Maia (5pm-3am).

artist_notes.name: Hot Since 82
artist_notes.note: UK house heavyweight and Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic extended sets.

404a1190c380.curator_note: The Sunday/Father's Day cap on the three-night park run — same Lake-and-Hot-Since-82 pairing as Saturday, so pick this only if the weekend night you want is already sold out.
404a1190c380.description: Third date of Chris Lake's LA State Historic Park run with Hot Since 82, an 18+ open-air tech-house party.

artist_notes.name: Cassian
artist_notes.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

artist_notes.name: Kamino
artist_notes.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

2f0dfdae90af.curator_note: Day Trip's daytime melodic-house format in the park, anchored by Cassian — the more emotional, Afterlife-leaning counterweight to the Lake tech-house weekend if peak-time isn't your mood.
2f0dfdae90af.description: Day Trip In The Park daytime melodic/progressive-house party at LA State Historic Park with Cassian, Kamino, Millero and LUMI.

artist_notes.name: Eddie C
artist_notes.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

78348cab1d1a.curator_note: An open-to-close set from Eddie C is exactly the kind of night to plant yourself for — no warmup DJ, no peak-time grandstanding, just one of the slo-mo disco crowd's best diggers building the room all night. Free with RSVP makes it a no-brainer.
78348cab1d1a.description: Eddie C plays an all-night open-to-close set of disco, edits and deep house at Bar Franca.

artist_notes.name: B-Wade
artist_notes.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

4fedbed9168f.curator_note: A recurring soulful-house residency in the back room of Gold Diggers — the warm, vocal, gospel-adjacent end of the spectrum rather than peak-time tools. Good low-key Friday if you want grooves over a big lineup.
4fedbed9168f.description: Recurring all-night soulful-house party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood, hosted by resident B-Wade.

bb41161eefe6.curator_note: George Miller's desert-chase masterpiece on the big screen at Vidiots — relentless, practical-stunt insanity that's worth seeing loud and projected rather than at home. Ari's flagged Vidiots as a venue he wants to get into; this is a great excuse.
bb41161eefe6.description: Repertory screening of Mad Max: Fury Road (2015, 121 min) at Vidiots in Eagle Rock.

artist_notes.name: LYDO
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Frankie Teardrop
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

7aecfa91d404.curator_note: A queer warehouse rave for Pride leaning fast and trance-y — LYDO and Frankie Teardrop are the real-deal underground end of that sound, not a generic circuit party. Skews harder and more peak-time than the rooftop-groove lane, so go in for the energy, not for selection.
7aecfa91d404.description: Location-TBA Pride warehouse party with queer-underground techno from LYDO, Frankie Teardrop, Miracles and J.dB.

artist_notes.name: Tamara Lanza
artist_notes.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

2353e1ad635b.curator_note: The pool-party edition of Sunset Sessions — the rooftop-vinyl-house series at Level 8 that's basically Ari's reference point for a good open-air Saturday. The lineup's local-resident rather than a marquee guest, but the setting and sound are the whole reason to go.
2353e1ad635b.description: Saturday afternoon pool-party edition of the Sunset Sessions rooftop house series at Level 8 DTLA, with Aplex, Tamara Lanza and Electric Field.

artist_notes.name: Antal
artist_notes.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

ec2ca5e297c2.curator_note: We Own The Night marks 15 years of its no-velvet-ropes 'real LA underground rare house' parties by flying Antal in from Amsterdam for an extended set — that's a serious pairing of crowd and selector, and exactly the dirty-disco-into-house energy worth chasing a TBA address for.
ec2ca5e297c2.description: We Own The Night's 15-year anniversary at a TBA downtown location, with an extended set from Rush Hour's Antal flying in from Amsterdam.

artist_notes.name: Reverberation Radio
artist_notes.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

169931f6acf3.curator_note: Not a four-on-the-floor night — this is the Allah-Las' crate-digging crew spinning psych, surf, library and global oddities off vinyl at Zebulon. A great listening-bar-flavored hang if you want grooves and discovery instead of a dancefloor.
169931f6acf3.description: Allah-Las' Reverberation Radio crew DJ a night of vintage psych, surf and global vinyl obscurities at Zebulon in Frogtown.

cbf00da01c90.curator_note: A morning camera-and-coffee meetup for the photo/video crowd — gear talk, coffee and shooting, not a music thing. Off the main lane unless Ari's specifically into the photography-community side.
cbf00da01c90.description: Free morning photography/videographer community meetup (gear + coffee) hosted by Dangycam; address drops after RSVP approval.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

artist_notes.name: john gerrard
artist_notes.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

deede894fa33.curator_note: A free summer-solstice dance at LACMA pairing Richie Hawtin with John Gerrard's 'SPIRITS' artwork — Hawtin in a museum-plaza art context rather than a club, so expect something more textural and hypnotic than a peak-time techno hammer. Worth it for the name and the setting; RSVP required.
deede894fa33.description: Free summer-solstice dance at LACMA with a techno set from Richie Hawtin, tied to artist john gerrard's 'SPIRITS' installation.

artist_notes.name: Dave Harrington
artist_notes.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

artist_notes.name: John Dwyer
artist_notes.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

artist_notes.name: Spencer Zahn
artist_notes.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

artist_notes.name: Aaron Steele
artist_notes.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

artist_notes.name: Tom Dolas
artist_notes.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

e00ad8085b0c.curator_note: A one-off improvising quintet built around Dave Harrington (Darkside) and Oh Sees' John Dwyer at Zebulon — heady, psych-leaning instrumental jamming rather than songs. Squarely in the experimental-band lane Ari wants surfaced, and Zebulon's the perfect room for it.
e00ad8085b0c.description: One-night improvising quintet — Dave Harrington (Darkside), John Dwyer (Oh Sees), Aaron Steele, Spencer Zahn and Tom Dolas — at Zebulon in Frogtown.

artist_notes.name: Yaeji
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017, debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL. A tracked name on a proper North American DJ tour right now.

artist_notes.name: Alima Lee
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

9ea5376be5a4.curator_note: Lights Down Low doing what it does best: TBA location drops day-of, and they've booked Yaeji on a dedicated DJ-set summer tour — whispered-bilingual-house in a warehouse rather than a festival tent is the right format for her. Worth the address chase.
9ea5376be5a4.description: Lights Down Low presents Yaeji DJ set (plus Alima Lee, Hu Dat, AMERICANRECYCLING) at a location-TBA downtown warehouse, 10pm, 21+.

artist_notes.name: Adam Beyer
artist_notes.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno that anchors the darker half of this lineup. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house heavyweight (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s with 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab ('Nightmares'); reliable festival-circuit crowd-mover. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-German DJ born Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; evolved from hip-hop residencies to Space/Hi Ibiza residencies; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythm into house and tech house.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo
artist_notes.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has dropped on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno pitched between festival and underground.

artist_notes.name: Elderbrook
artist_notes.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' (CamelPhat collab, Grammy-nominated) made him; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act rather than a DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but a shade more radio-pop.

artist_notes.name: Sidepiece
artist_notes.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house rooted in Motown edits.

artist_notes.name: Westend
artist_notes.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped draft the modern American tech-house blueprint; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

artist_notes.name: Josh Baker
artist_notes.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy, fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project.

artist_notes.name: Riordan
artist_notes.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm, plus Black Book and Catch & Release.

artist_notes.name: Greg 99
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee; Insomniac Records debut.

bb4f346b7a87.curator_note: Day Trip's sixth Long Beach edition at the new Queen Mary Amphitheater is the tech-house festival LA actually needs — the Adam Beyer / Loco Dice / Hi-Lo block gives it real techno weight, and Cloonee headlining keeps it from disappearing up its own prog-house backside. Saturday is the day to go.
bb4f346b7a87.description: Day Trip Festival sixth edition at Queen Mary Waterfront, Long Beach — two-day house/techno/melodic fest with Adam Beyer, Cloonee, Loco Dice, Hi-Lo, Elderbrook, Hayden James, Sidepiece, Westend and 50+ others.

artist_notes.name: Stacey Pullen
artist_notes.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse, ran Blackflag Recordings, and cut the acclaimed DJ-Kicks in 1996. Known aliases: Bango, Kosmik Messenger, Silent Phase. A tracked name bringing genuine Detroit lineage to this TBA night.

artist_notes.name: BAE BAE
artist_notes.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave. Sets move freely through Black diasporic club music: footwork, juke, breaks, R&B; a key figure in LA's queer underground.

artist_notes.name: Nish
artist_notes.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward, soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first curatorial approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

58579f941eb8.curator_note: Dirty Epic and INCOGNITO have been landing Berghain-calibre bookings for years, and Stacey Pullen for a TBA late night is exactly that — second-wave Detroit in an intimate warehouse rather than a stage. BAE BAE warming up keeps the energy genuinely interesting rather than just competent.
58579f941eb8.description: Dirty Epic x INCOGNITO present Stacey Pullen (Detroit techno) alongside BAE BAE and Nish at a TBA Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm-4am, $25-30.

artist_notes.name: DJ Toka
artist_notes.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012, now at Exchange LA) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house, and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

3bb8aa27a866.curator_note: Sudamericana has been one of LA's most freewheeling Latin dance parties for over a decade — early 6pm start at Exchange LA, free with RSVP, and DJ Toka knows exactly how to move the room between cumbia, disco, and house without losing the floor.
3bb8aa27a866.description: Sudamericana monthly Latin house/disco party at Exchange LA, DTLA, with resident DJ Toka, 6pm, free with RSVP.

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator, M-Plant founder — co-founder of Underground Resistance alongside Jeff Mills and Mad Mike, then reduced the form to its bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). A tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno sets; hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

artist_notes.name: Ønyx
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ active on the city's underground techno circuit; has an RA profile and plays the same WORK/INCOGNITO-adjacent events — limited wider footprint, included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio's earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

0f729582faa3.curator_note: Robert Hood in a TBA warehouse on July 4th is the anti-fireworks plan — stripped, relentless M-Plant minimal with a crew of actual LA heads supporting. WORK's format (address drops day-of) means the room stays self-selecting, which is exactly right for this.
0f729582faa3.description: WORK presents Robert Hood (M-Plant, Detroit) with Disco Zombie, Ønyx and Rubbermiro at a TBA Los Angeles warehouse, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Jayda G
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ (Jacinda Gulley) — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul in her selections. Tracked name.

7e00f46a7221.curator_note: Sound is a proper room for Jayda G — she thrives in longer, sweatier sets where she can pull the floor through disco into gospel-house without hitting a hard stop. This is the July 4th pick if warehouse TBAs feel like too much admin.
7e00f46a7221.description: Jayda G (Ninja Tune) headlines Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Robert Hood
artist_notes.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — his stripped drum/bassline formula on 'Minimal Nation' (1994) is the blueprint for a significant chunk of modern techno. Tracked name.

artist_notes.name: Disco Zombie
artist_notes.note: LA-based techno DJ, dark and groovy underground techno; KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host.

artist_notes.name: Onyx
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno DJ; active on the WORK / Dirty Epic circuit. Limited wider footprint.

artist_notes.name: Rubbermiro
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ — KCHUNG Radio earlyafters, Dirty Epic / WORK circuit regular. Dark, groovy sets.

241179720c5f.curator_note: Same Robert Hood / Disco Zombie / Ønyx / Rubbermiro lineup as the WORK event — likely a duplicate listing. Confirm before buying tickets; the WORK-branded version (0f729582faa3) is the canonical one to trust.
241179720c5f.description: Robert Hood (M-Plant, Detroit) with Disco Zombie, Onyx and Rubbermiro at a TBA Los Angeles location, 10pm — appears to be the same event as the WORK-presented listing.

e667ba3ea44d.curator_note: LA Discoteca is a recurring night at The Slipper Clutch doing what the name says — disco and house in a basement-y DTLA room. No headliner detail in the billing, so treat it as a low-effort add-on to a Friday that already has Yaeji or Stacey Pullen on it.
e667ba3ea44d.description: LA DISCOTECA recurring disco/house night at The Slipper Clutch, DTLA, 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Enayet
artist_notes.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh using deep soundsystem pressure and South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh. Slippery, off-kilter club rhythms.

artist_notes.name: K Wata
artist_notes.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, also a SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; has produced for Yaeji and contributed to the james K remix album. The duo have played as E Wata together.

a2ec0d8dd081.curator_note: CSW (Costumed Suicide Watcher) and SLINK booking Enayet + K Wata all-night is a genuine curatorial swing — SLINK's whole thing is polyrhythmic club mutations that don't resolve neatly into any genre, which makes for unpredictable, genuinely interesting late nights. Different proposition from the Stacey Pullen or Robert Hood options on the same weekend.
a2ec0d8dd081.description: CSW and SLINK present Enayet and K Wata (SLINK, NYC) playing all night at a TBA downtown LA location, 10pm, live/DJ.

artist_notes.name: discostan
artist_notes.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South and West Asian / North African music: 1980s disco, folkloric sounds, dancefloor re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW. One of a kind in LA.

da4e3fe70e19.curator_note: Discostan at El Cid is one of LA's genuinely singular recurring nights — Arshia Haq and crew weave SWANA folkloric music, '80s diaspora disco and re-edits into something no other promoter is doing in the city. Different enough from the house/techno lane to feel like a real discovery rather than a lateral move.
da4e3fe70e19.description: Discostan at El Cid, Silver Lake — the LA SWANA diaspora dance collective (Arshia Haq, co-founder) playing South/West Asian and North African disco, re-edits and folkloric dancefloor music, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: Pocari G
artist_notes.note: LA-based house DJ — active in the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint, name included on billing confidence.

artist_notes.name: Ashtre
artist_notes.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

artist_notes.name: Costa
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

artist_notes.name: Oso Disco
artist_notes.note: LA DJ name — local disco/house selector; included per billing.

artist_notes.name: Blaze Claze
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

4d5f11e375f5.curator_note: Butterground is a local DTLA house collective running TBA-location parties — all local selectors, no marquee name, but that format at 9pm on July 4th usually means an early crowd that's actually there to dance rather than pose. Worth watching if you're already out that night.
4d5f11e375f5.description: Butterground house collective party at a TBA DTLA location with Pocari G, Ashtre, Costa, Oso Disco and Blaze Claze, 9pm.

a686cbd059dc.curator_note: INLAND GROOVE running a 2am afterhours on July 4th in DTLA — no lineup detail, which is how these things go. If you're already at Robert Hood or Jayda G and want to keep moving, this is the move; if you're picking cold, wait for the lineup drop.
a686cbd059dc.description: INLAND GROOVE afterhours party at a DTLA location, starting 2am on July 4th — lineup TBA.

artist_notes.name: Halo Varga
artist_notes.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owns Artifact Record Shop. House and techno with deep Chicago roots and a European finish.

artist_notes.name: Dylan Payne
artist_notes.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — soul-forward, all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

artist_notes.name: Highkin'
artist_notes.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

4b5718ac6609.curator_note: MARBLE runs proper Arts District afterhours — a 10pm-to-7am window with Halo Varga, one of fabric's original residents, at the top of the bill. The fabric lineage plus Dylan Payne's vinyl microhouse is the right combination for anyone who wants to go deep rather than wide tonight.
4b5718ac6609.description: MARBLE afterhours at a TBA Arts District location with Halo Varga (fabric/All Inn), Dylan Payne, Hazy, PabloDiscobar and more, 10pm-7am, $20-37.

artist_notes.name: Flying Mojito Bros
artist_notes.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda. Genuinely odd and fun in the right way.

artist_notes.name: Brainstory
artist_notes.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; live band performing at this Camille's date, not a DJ set. A bit outside the pure dance lane but with real groove DNA.

fd9f6e2edd10.curator_note: Flying Mojito Bros are a left-field booking for Camille's — their cosmic country-funk-to-acid-house sets are genuinely weird and don't fit a clean genre box, which tends to make for memorable nights. Brainstory are a live band so this is a hybrid show/club format; go for the FMB set if you want to dance.
fd9f6e2edd10.description: Flying Mojito Bros (cosmic disco/acid house, UK) and live soul-jazz act Brainstory at Camille's at The Bellwether, 9pm-2am, $24.

c272d34d687c.curator_note: Inland Groove's Saturday-night afterhours edition — free before 1am with RSVP, $10 after, runs to 5am. No lineup announced yet; check closer to the night. The brand has a consistent house-focused sound and the same TBA-DTLA format as their July 4 edition.
c272d34d687c.description: Inland Groove afterhours at a TBA DTLA location, Sat June 27, 11pm-5am — free with RSVP before 1am, $10 after.

f4fe507771f1.curator_note: Gold Diggers' Groove Room is a no-frills house party in a small East Hollywood room — the name says it, house and hits on a Friday night with no headliner. The kind of unpretentious local spot worth walking to from Silver Lake if you want to dance without a ticket line.
f4fe507771f1.description: Groove Room recurring house and dancefloor-hits party at Gold Diggers, East Hollywood, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Ginger Root
artist_notes.note: Cameron Lew's solo project out of Huntington Beach — indie soul/alt-disco/boogie and Japanese city pop influences; his recordings are meticulously crafted handmade synth-pop. This is a DJ set appearance, not a live band show — expect disco, boogie, and city-pop records rather than his own material.

cf65e6d3a51e.curator_note: Ginger Root doing a DJ set at Camille's is a fun oddity — his music sits in the boogie/alt-disco zone and a free DJ night lets him play his influences rather than perform. Low commitment, free entry, and a nice change of pace from the heavier club nights on the same night.
cf65e6d3a51e.description: Ginger Root (Cameron Lew, indie soul/alt-disco) plays a free DJ set at Camille's at The Bellwether, 8pm-2am.

d26b1c2aec3d.curator_note: The Hustle on July 4th is the same format as every first-and-third Saturday — Gold Diggers' reliable disco-and-boogie residency, no headliner, just the residents doing their thing in a small East Hollywood room. Easy late add to a Fourth if the warehouse TBAs don't pan out.
d26b1c2aec3d.description: The Hustle recurring first-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers, East Hollywood, July 4, 10:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Eli Escobar
artist_notes.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco and jazzy house through funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor. A proper New York DJ with the range to go long.

9412d5b2209e.curator_note: Midnight Lovers booking Eli Escobar for a TBA July 4th date is a solid pull — he's one of New York's most versatile selectors, the kind of DJ who can stretch a set from disco to cumbia and keep everyone dancing. The TBA format means the room will be self-selecting, which is exactly right for this.
9412d5b2209e.description: Midnight Lovers presents Eli Escobar (Night People NYC, Tiki Disco) at a TBA DTLA location, July 4, 7pm-2am, $22 advance.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

yaeji.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL Recordings, second album 'With A Hammer' (2023). Breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017. On a dedicated DJ-set North American summer tour 2026. Tracked name.

alima lee.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno; one of the most reliably excellent festival techno sets alive. Tracked name.

cloonee.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers. Tracked name.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house. Records on Ovum, M-nus, Cadenza, Cocoon.

hi-lo.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has released on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno bridging festival and underground.

elderbrook.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' with CamelPhat was Grammy-nominated 2018; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act, not a DJ set.

hayden james.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); worked with Gorgon City and Katy Perry; RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but slightly more radio-pop.

sidepiece.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house with Motown and '90s soul edits.

westend.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped define modern American tech house; Kick & Bass Records founder; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

josh baker.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project; also runs SYNTHO production school.

riordan.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm; also on Black Book and Catch & Release.

greg 99.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee (6.6M streams); Insomniac Records debut.

stacey pullen.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse in the '90s; Blackflag Recordings founder; acclaimed DJ-Kicks (1996); also releases as Bango, Kosmik Messenger and Silent Phase. Tracked name.

bae bae.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

nish.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

dj toka.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks; stripped techno to bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994, Tresor/Axis). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). Tracked name.

disco zombie.note: LA techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno; co-hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

onyx.note: LA-based underground techno DJ, active on the WORK / INCOGNITO circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

rubbermiro.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ Jacinda Gulley — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul. Tracked name.

enayet.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh; polyrhythmic club music with South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh.

k wata.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; produced for Yaeji; contributed to james K 'Friend' remix album.

discostan.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric sounds, re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW.

pocari g.note: LA-based house DJ active on the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

ashtre.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

oso disco.note: LA disco/house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

blaze claze.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

halo varga.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn Records, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owner of Artifact Record Shop. Deep Chicago house roots with a European finish.

dylan payne.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

highkin'.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

flying mojito bros.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda.

brainstory.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; primarily a live band, not a DJ act. Some groove DNA but a different lane from the dance floor.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew's solo project from Huntington Beach — immaculately crafted indie soul, alt-disco, boogie and Japanese city pop; primarily a live band but occasionally performs DJ sets. Influences include Vulfpeck, Toro y Moi and Yellow Magic Orchestra.

eli escobar.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.
